brief: Owner, 2026-11-26: the OpenCode Go allowance is spent; use Anthropic through Claude Agent where needed, and use OpenCode Zen free models where possible to reduce Anthropic cost.

entry: Build/Fix on opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free, QA on opencode/beam-free, snapshot helpers on opencode/mimo-v2.6-flash-free, and other non-judging work on a free model; each was checked on a task with a known answer.
